comment: files.c fopen_datafile() on the judge's APFS volume, which compares names as UTF-8 after canonical decomposition and Unicode case folding. Keys are C's bytes. #wizloaddes KELVIN SIGN + 'nox' (U+212A decomposes to K) opens knox.lua; LONG S + 'oko1-1' (U+017F folds to s) opens soko1-1.lua. The byte 0xFF ends getlin() as an escape would, so the third command loads nothing and the keys after it run as commands. On Linux the first two print "nhl_loadlua: Error opening", so this recording must come from macOS (recorder run 44669396862; scripts/playground-case.test.mjs). Seed, date, gnomish Healer and names chosen independently.
